summary: Iteration 86 - Staff Management Panel Testing Complete. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: Users tab with table, role filters, search, Add/Edit User dialogs with branch_payments. My Shifts tab with weekly calendar. Roles & Permissions tab with role list showing user counts and permission counts. Fixed 2 bugs: (1) my-shifts endpoint now allows housekeeper/maintenance roles, (2) Roles tab was crashing due to incorrect API response parsing.
